dist.description: Debian/Ubuntu release codename (e.g., bullseye, jammy, noble). Must match available mirror.

arch.description: Target architecture (e.g., amd64, arm64). Leave empty to build for the host architecture.

base_tgz_path.description: Path to the cowbuilder base image tarball. cowbuilder reuses this snapshot for fast rebuilds.

mirror_url.description: Base APT mirror URL. Must be reachable and support the requested distribution.

extra_sources.description: Additional APT repository entries (e.g., security, backports). Each item adds one sources.list line.

comment.description: Optional human-readable comment for the source (e.g., 'Debian security updates')

content.description: Exact line to write into /etc/apt/sources.list (e.g., 'deb http://security.debian.org/ bullseye-security main')

extra_packages.description: Additional packages to install in the build chroot (e.g., ['build-essential', 'devscripts']).

cowcow_opts.description: Options passed to cow when invoked by cowbuilder. Common: '--no-copyonwrite' or '--shared-tmpfs'.

use_cow.description: Enable copy-on-write for speed (requires overlay filesystem support). Set to true only if /var/cache/cow is on a COW-capable FS (e.g., btrfs).

hooks.description: Custom hook scripts (pre-build, post-build, etc.). Scripts run inside the chroot unless otherwise noted.

type.description: Hook type; determines when it runs.

script_path.description: Absolute path to the executable script (must be present in the build host, e.g., /usr/local/bin/cow-prebuild.sh).

env_vars.description: Environment variables to export inside the chroot (e.g., {'DEB_BUILD_OPTIONS': 'parallel=4'}).

build_dir.description: Working directory inside the chroot where source is unpacked and compiled.

output_dir.description: Directory on the host where built .deb files are copied after a successful build.
